scientific_integrity: All finite computational comparisons are corroboration, not a substitute for the all-size proof. No independent scientific audit or certification performed.
scientific_limitations: Only two equal-magnitude negative bonds in an otherwise positive classical Ising ring at zero field; result is for Var(M)/n, not physical beta Var(M)/n. No unique continuum optimizer proved, numerical c* illustrative, independent historical coverage review outstanding.
title: An exact separation principle and macroscopic thermal peak for two antiferromagnetic bonds on an Ising ring
